description: Run by the renovate job in .gitlab-ci.yml. Opens merge requests into dev, which run every pipeline check.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the waiting period and the Monday schedule.

packageRules.description: Images stay pinned to a digest (see IMAGE PINNING in .gitlab-ci.yml).
One merge request per workspace for minor and patch npm updates.
One merge request per workspace for minor and patch npm updates.
The Docker CLI and the Docker-in-Docker service must stay on the same version.
@types/node follows the Node.js major version the code runs on (24).
TypeScript stays on 6: the NestJS 12 CLI requires it, and TypeScript 7's native compiler is not yet supported by the tooling (README, Version notes).
Drop the seroval overrides in frontend/package.json once solid-js (under @tanstack/react-query-devtools) depends on seroval 1.6.8 or later itself: solid-js 1.9.16 does.

The CI test database matches the staging server's PostgreSQL major version (17). Raise this limit when the server is upgraded. The db-backup service in docker-compose.staging.yml may move ahead: a newer pg_dump can dump an older server.
